title: MS Dhoni Transitions to Mentor, Robert Pattinson Becomes James Bond Amidst Viral Controversies and Box Office Records
summary: This week's AI news round-up covers significant shifts in the sports and entertainment world, with MS Dhoni retiring as a player to become CSK's mentor and Robert Pattinson officially announced as the new James Bond. Social media was abuzz with influencer drama involving Kashvi, Scout, and Luv, alongside a quirky viral "animal Twitter war" and a unique GTA 6 pre-nuptial agreement. Meanwhile, Bollywood faced serious threats against Amitabh Bachchan, and actor Sharad Kapoor found support for his comeback. The legal landscape saw a heated exchange between a lawyer and the Chief Justice of India, while a tragic Chhath Puja incident and a family's Vande Bharat train blunder highlighted pressing social issues.
article:
The past week has delivered a diverse range of headlines, from major career announcements in sports and cinema to viral internet phenomena and somber societal reflections. The world of cricket witnessed a significant transition, while Hollywood welcomed a new iconic spy.

### MS Dhoni's New Role and IPL Future

Legendary cricketer MS Dhoni is reportedly set to retire as a player from the Indian Premier League (IPL) ahead of the 2027 season. While reports suggest he will no longer feature in CSK's playing XI, he will remain an integral part of the franchise. Official confirmations indicate that Dhoni has been appointed as a mentor for Chennai Super Kings, marking the first IPL edition where he will not be on the field as a player. Dhoni previously retired from Test cricket in 2014 and international cricket in 2020, and his IPL retirement in 2026 as a player marks the end of an illustrious era, though his continued involvement as a mentor ensures his legacy endures.

### Robert Pattinson Dons the James Bond Mantle

In a monumental announcement that has thrilled cinema enthusiasts, actor Robert Pattinson has officially been confirmed as the new James Bond. This news places Pattinson in an elite group of actors who have portrayed the iconic British spy. Already known for his portrayal of Batman, Pattinson now holds the unique distinction of being both Batman and James Bond simultaneously. His career trajectory, from his breakout role in "Twilight" to leading roles in critically acclaimed films, and now as two major cinematic figures, showcases a remarkable generational run.

### Reality TV Drama: Kashvi, Scout, and Luv's Public Spats

The influencer and reality TV circuits were rife with controversy this week, primarily centered around Kashvi and her perceived jabs at fellow personalities Scout and Luv. A seemingly innocuous social media post by Kashvi, where she commented on a friend's desire to remarry with "a child needs a sibling," quickly spiraled into speculation that she was taking a dig at Scout and Luv's relationship. The comment drew significant criticism, prompting Kashvi to clarify that she was referring to her friend's son, whose name is also Kashvi, and urged people to stop taking things out of context.

This incident coincided with ongoing drama between Scout and Luv, exacerbated by their stint on "Bigg Boss." During a "Weekend Ka Vaar" episode, host Salman Khan reportedly advised Scout that his game was suffering due to Luv's influence. Housemates also suggested Luv was manipulating Scout, leading Scout to distance himself. A recent promo showed Scout even shouting at Luv during an argument involving Amrapali, where Luv warned against commenting on his character. The public drama continues to fuel speculation and fan discourse around these reality TV figures.

### Viral Internet Phenomena: From Animal Twitter Wars to Gaming Contracts

The internet offered its share of peculiar viral moments. A bizarre "Twitter war" erupted between verified accounts representing various animals and birds. It began with a tweet from "Sparrow" dissing pigeons, which escalated into a multi-animal exchange involving pigeons, chickens, horses, and dogs, each posting witty and savage replies. The lighthearted feud captivated millions, garnering immense engagement.

In the gaming world, the highly anticipated "GTA 6" generated significant buzz even before its release. The game has already raked in an astounding $1.5 billion in pre-orders, selling 15 million units and underscoring its immense hype. Adding to the viral content, a "girlfriend contract" for playing GTA 6 circulated online. The contract, signed by a couple, included terms such as checking on the girlfriend every few hours, pausing the game for conversations, limiting playtime to 50% of off-time, and acknowledging that the game's character Lucia is not the real girlfriend. This humorous yet serious agreement highlighted the cultural impact and anticipation surrounding the game.

### Bollywood and Legal Scrutiny: Threats to Bachchans and a CJI Controversy

Bollywood icon Amitabh Bachchan and his son Abhishek Bachchan faced a serious threat from Goldie Dillon, reportedly affiliated with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. This development followed a security alert outside the Bachchan family home where two suspects were arrested. Dillon's threatening post referenced Amitabh Bachchan's remarks during the 1984 Anti-Sikh Riots, claiming they fueled violence, and vowed revenge, stating that no security measure, not even a bulletproof enclosure, would deter them.

Meanwhile, actor Sharad Kapoor, known for films like "Dastak" and "Josh," received an outpouring of support after an appeal video detailing his severe health and financial struggles went viral. Sonu Sood immediately offered medical assistance, and reports indicate Salman Khan personally promised financial aid. This collective support has turned Kapoor's fortunes around, with an update suggesting he is now slated for a Hollywood debut within two months, starting in January.

In a rare and dramatic incident in the Supreme Court, a lawyer's urgent hearing request escalated into a direct confrontation with the Chief Justice of India (CJI). The lawyer, reportedly upset over a contempt case, bypassed usual procedures and publicly challenged the CJI's integrity and right to sit on the bench. The live stream of the proceedings was subsequently muted, and the lawyer was escorted out. While calls for strict action against the lawyer have been made, no official measures have been taken yet.

### Social and Human Interest Stories: Tragedy, Disputes, and Unique Celebrations

A deeply tragic incident unfolded during preparations for Chhath Puja, where a four-year-old girl was allegedly killed by her mother for eating 'prasad' before the ritual, which is against tradition. The child's father recounted that the mother fatally assaulted the girl for breaking the custom. Despite efforts to save her, the child succumbed to her injuries. The father has demanded action against his wife, who has since been arrested, highlighting the devastating consequences of extreme adherence to tradition.

A peculiar dispute at a railway station went viral when a shopkeeper confronted a youth for using his "personal" dustbin. After consuming a drink, the youth disposed of the can in a dustbin near a shop, only to be reprimanded by the shopkeeper, who insisted it was for his personal use and not for public garbage. The incident sparked public outrage, with many calling for the shopkeeper's license suspension and questioning the lack of public dustbins from railway authorities, who have since escalated the matter for necessary action.

In a heartwarming yet unusual story, an 80-year-old man from Uttar Pradesh performed his own 'terahvin' (13th-day death ritual) while still alive. Lacking a son and wishing not to burden his daughters with the responsibility after his passing, he meticulously planned the event as a grand celebration, hiring eight cooks and inviting 900 guests. The ceremony included a fire ritual and a turban-tying ceremony for his grandson, symbolizing the passing of the family headship.

Finally, a family faced a costly blunder on a Vande Bharat train. Twelve relatives who went to see off a family member on the train found themselves trapped inside when the automatic doors closed. Unable to exit and with the train departing, they panicked, pulling the chain without success. They were only able to disembark at the next station, 150 km away, but were fined a collective Rs 36,000 for traveling without tickets, serving as a stark reminder of the train's automated system.
